name: GRay
definition: A fast ray tracer for 3D Gaussians designed to close the performance gap between ray tracing and rasterization (3DGS) by leveraging the algorithmic difference where ray tracing evaluates only intersected Gaussians, allowing logarithmic scaling in dense scenes with tiny Gaussians.
summary: GRay is a fast ray-tracing method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses a BVH to evaluate only intersected Gaussians, offering logarithmic scaling and faster optimization than rasterization.
